prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Miami for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” dentist for implants in Miami — the right provider depends on your needs (single tooth vs full-arch, bone grafting needs, sedation, budget, timeline) and your preferences (surgical specialist vs restorative dentist). I can help you find a great match. Before that, here are practical guidelines and next steps.

What type of specialist to look for
- Oral and maxillofacial surgeon (OMFS): best for complex surgery, bone grafting and IV sedation.
- Periodontist: gum and bone specialists with lots of implant experience.
- Prosthodontist: specialist in restoring teeth — ideal when aesthetics and complex prosthetics are key.
- Restorative dentist with advanced implant training: fine for straightforward cases if they work with a surgical specialist.

Key credentials and experience to check
- Board certification or specialty membership (AAOMS, AAP, AAID, ICOI, ACP).
- Years placing implants and number placed per year.
- Experience with the implant system(s) they use.
- Use of modern tech: CBCT 3D imaging, guided/digital implant planning, intraoral scanning.
- Before-and-after cases and patient photos.
- Transparent treatment plan, timeline, complications policy and fees.

Questions to ask at consultation
- How many implants like mine have you placed?
- Do you place and restore the implant yourself or work with a team?
- Which implant system do you use and why?
- Will I need bone grafting or sinus lift? How often do you perform those?
- What sedation/anesthesia options are available?
- What’s the full cost, and what’s included (surgery, restoration, follow-ups)?
- Can I see before/after photos and patient references?
- What is your complication rate and how are complications handled?

How to find & verify providers in Miami
- Use AAOMS, AAID or ICOI directories to find specialists.
- Check recent Google, Healthgrades and RealSelf reviews (look at specific implant cases).
- Ask for referrals from your general dentist or friends/family.
- Get a second opinion for large or expensive plans.

If you want, I can:
- Search for highly rated implant surgeons/prosthodontists/periodontists in Miami and give you a short list (I’ll need your zip code or neighborhood and any preferences: price, sedation, same-day/loading implants, insurance).

Which would you like me to do next?
